2607.24031.title: A Cyclic Adaptation-Generalization Framework with Uncertainty-Guided Self-Paced Learning for Long-Term Brain-Machine Interfaces
2607.24031.paper_summary: Brain-Machine Interfaces (BMIs), which link the brain to external devices, hold great potential in rehabilitation, human performance augmentation, and human-centered robotics. However, invasive BMIs face a critical challenge for long-term deployment due to neural drift, which degrades decoding performance over time and necessitates frequent recalibration. Existing methods designed to mitigate neural drift typically rely on either domain adaptation (DA) or domain generalization (DG) alone and often fail to capture fine-grained distribution shifts across neural subdomains, resulting in limited performance. To overcome these limitations, we propose Uncertainty-guided Self-paced Cycling (UnSPC), a robust framework that synergizes DA and DG for target domain refining under an Uncertainty-guided Self-paced Pseudo-labeling (UnSPL) mechanism. To handle subdomain neural drift across domains, UNSPL is proposed to iteratively mine reliable pseudo-labeled samples with a noise-robust ranking strategy for further fine-tuning. Leveraging these high-quality samples, we introduce a novel Cycling Adaptation and Generalization (CycAG) strategy, which integrates DA and DG within an iterative cycle to progressively mitigate both global and subdomain drift. This cyclic process enables effective alignment to evolving target distributions while preserving robust and transferable representations, thereby mitigating performance degradation under long-term neural drifts. Extensive experiments on multiple neural decoding datasets demonstrate the effectiveness and robustness of UnSPC. To our knowledge, our proposed UnSPC is the first to cyclically integrate DA and DG with pseudo-labeling, paving the way toward stable long-term BMI controls.
2607.24031.paper_summary_zh: 腦機介面（BMIs）將大腦與外部設備連接，具有在康復、人類性能增強和以人為中心的機器人技術方面的巨大潛力。<lb/>然而，侵入式腦機介面在長期部署中面臨著一個關鍵挑戰，即神經漂移，這會隨著時間的推移降低解碼性能，並需要頻繁的重新校準。<lb/>現有旨在減少神經漂移的方法通常僅依賴於領域適應（DA）或領域泛化（DG），並且往往無法捕捉神經子域之間的細微分佈變化，導致性能有限。<lb/>為了克服這些限制，我們提出了不確定性引導的自適應循環（UnSPC），這是一個強大的框架，通過不確定性引導的自適應偽標籤（UnSPL）機制協同DA和DG以精煉目標領域。<lb/>為了處理跨領域的子域神經漂移，提出了UNSPL，通過具有抗噪聲排名策略的可靠偽標記樣本進行迭代挖掘，以進行進一步的微調。<lb/>利用這些高質量樣本，我們引入了一種新穎的循環適應和泛化（CycAG）策略，該策略在迭代循環中整合DA和DG，以逐步減輕全球和子域漂移。<lb/>這一循環過程使得有效對齊不斷演變的目標分佈，同時保持穩健和可轉移的表示，從而減輕長期神經漂移下的性能衰退。<lb/>在多個神經解碼數據集上的廣泛實驗證明了UnSPC的有效性和穩健性。<lb/>據我們所知，我們提出的UnSPC是首個將DA和DG與偽標籤循環整合的系統，為穩定的長期腦機控制鋪平了道路。
